applications.title: Site Plan for 7540 Main St.- Local Motive Expansion

fields.description: The applicants are presenting a site plan showing an expansion of the Local Motive bar, located at 7540 Main St., into an existing space at the rear of the building.  No exterior modifications are planned as part of this request meaning that the building footprint and exterior site layout will remain the same. All principle permitted uses in the B-L zone, where a building permit and zoning certificate are required, are also subject to a site plan review by the Planning Commission per Town Code §180-95.
